primaryUnit: one application-runtime-owned target code file per main-tree leaf; no omitted application source files, no auxiliary code expansion
include: APK-built-in runtime JS/HTML/CSS/SQL or other actual execution code
application component declarations as needed to explain runtime structure
separateInventories: complete application-target source manifest, every main-tree code leaf represented
auxiliary test/tool/build/documentation manifests outside main tree, referenced by purpose/path
resource/external/generated inventories or rules, summarized not expanded as application code
checks: main-tree leaves equal complete application-runtime source manifest, no ellipsis
auxiliary/test/build/document files never classified as application-runtime merely because path is under app
actual built-in extension/script execution code is application code, not mistaken for test helper
every test reference records coverage goal + target path + validation state
normalized unique relative paths and resolvable cross references
new/renamed/retired runtime source updates manifest and tree together
deferred storage implementation is not silently made an active dependency
notImplemented: no product files moved/removed/replaced by this policy
referencesInsteadOfExpansion: test requirement + exact planned test path at related application node
resources/assets inventories and manifest/config location when relevant
legacy maintenance/release assets as external retained-reference summary
